runConfig.positivePrompt: Static wide camera. One complete full-body Tyrannosaurus rex stands firmly in place and performs one large, clearly visible silent roar. The dinosaur raises its deep head slightly and opens the lower jaw smoothly to a strong natural thirty-degree gape, clearly revealing one stable row of upper teeth, one stable row of lower teeth, a low tongue, and the dark mouth interior. Hold the open-mouth display briefly, expand the throat once, then close the jaw and settle. Make the jaw opening and head lift large and unmistakable across the frame. Keep the broad deep skull, short muscular neck, two tiny two-fingered arms, both planted feet, torso, pelvis, and complete tail anatomically continuous. The body does not walk or turn. Preserve the exact attached dinosaur identity, forest, ground, lighting, crop, and fixed camera. Silent, non-graphic, child-safe behavior hypothesis for ages five to fourteen.
